verdict.rationale: MoonPay's evidence only describes an MCP server that lets external AI agents search/retrieve documentation content (moonpay-docs-6, moonpay-probe-3) — this is a developer-docs tool, not a built-in AI assistant inside the product that end-users can delegate purchase/sell/swap tasks to. No evidence of any in-product assistant, chat interface, or agentic task delegation for users.
